faults.name: decode_double_range
faults.why: every slave decodes twice its range, so part of a hole (or a neighbour) is sent to it

faults.name: round_robin_stuck
faults.why: the read arbiter never moves on, so the lowest-numbered master wins every contest

faults.name: bresp_dropped
faults.why: a slave's SLVERR is passed back as OKAY

faults.name: decerr_stale_data
faults.why: a read of an unmapped address returns the previous read's data with DECERR

faults.name: awvalid_waits_for_wready
faults.why: AWVALID depends on the slave's WREADY and drops when it falls (IHI 0022H A3.2.1, A3.3.1)

faults.name: b_before_slave_response
faults.why: the master sees BVALID while the write is still being forwarded

faults.name: wstrb_forced
faults.why: byte strobes are lost, so a partial write becomes a full-word write

faults.name: write_round_robin_stuck
faults.why: the write arbiter never moves on, so the lowest-numbered master wins every write contest (from the review)

faults.name: busy_not_reset
faults.why: the slaves' busy flags start at 0 at power-up but a reset does not clear them, so a reset with a transfer in flight leaves a stale request (from the review)
